title: Agent-First Tooling
acceptance_criteria: A coding agent can discover the project, inspect one declaration, and retrieve direct and transitive dependencies through bounded deterministic JSON.
Diagnostic explanations expose compiler-owned evidence and authorized remediation.
Change-impact output is compiler-owned and bounded.
The documented workflow is executable and regression-tested.
